why: A tag is a movable reference. A full commit SHA is the only immutable way to reference an action, and an image digest identifies exact bytes where a tag may later resolve to different ones. Before governed OCR, everything in the execution path is pinned to an immutable reference and the human-readable release is recorded beside it.

runtimeImage.nodeVersion: 20.x, recorded by discovery from the running container
runtimeImage.verifiedBy: the workflow pulls by digest, inspects the image and halts with RUNTIME_IMAGE_DIGEST_MISMATCH if the resolved image is not the pinned one; discovery independently records the running platform and node version

pinnedRuntimeIdentity.why: Discovery observed uid 0 inside the boundary. Capabilities were dropped and no-new-privileges was set, but nothing pinned a non-root user. Documenting uid 0 as accepted was not sufficient.
pinnedRuntimeIdentity.verifiedBy: discovery reads process.getuid()/getgid() and compares them against ISSUE_149_EXPECTED_UID/GID
